2609.20131.title: Think Thrice Before Reranking: Multi-perspective Evidence and Reasoning Integration for Text Reranking
2609.20131.paper_summary: Reasoning-based reranking with Large Language Models (LLMs) has shown promising improvements in text ranking. However, current methods predominantly rely on a single reasoning trajectory, resulting in rankings that are susceptible to reasoning errors and inherently constrained in modeling the multifaceted signals underlying document relevance. To resolve this dilemma, we propose MERIT-Rank(Multi-perspective Evidence and Reasoning Integration for Text Reranking), a framework that models complementary reasoning trajectories to improve reranking robustness. MERIT-Rank formulates a Multi-Trajectory Reasoning Space (MTRS) that evaluates query-document relevance from multiple perspectives and introduces a joint reranker that consolidates these reasoning paths into a unified ranking decision. We further develop Progressive Rank Policy Optimization (PRPO), a progressive training framework that stabilizes reasoning trajectories while continually improving ranking quality through staged optimization objectives. Experiments on both reasoning-intensive and traditional retrieval benchmarks show that MERIT-Rank consistently achieves superior performance over competitive baselines. The 4B model notably outperforms most 7B and even 32B rerankers on BRIGHT.
2609.20131.paper_summary_zh: 基於推理的重排序與大型語言模型（LLMs）在文本排名上顯示出有前景的改進。<lb/>然而，目前的方法主要依賴於單一的推理軌跡，導致排名容易受到推理錯誤的影響，並在建模文檔相關性的多面向信號方面固有地受到限制。<lb/>為了解決這一困境，我們提出了MERIT-Rank（多角度證據與推理整合的文本重排序），這是一個建模互補推理軌跡以提高重排序穩健性的框架。<lb/>MERIT-Rank構建了一個多軌跡推理空間（MTRS），從多個角度評估查詢-文檔的相關性，並引入了一個聯合重排序器，將這些推理路徑整合為統一的排名決策。<lb/>我們進一步開發了漸進排名政策優化（PRPO），這是一個漸進式訓練框架，穩定推理軌跡，同時通過分階優化目標不斷提高排名質量。<lb/>在推理密集型和傳統檢索基準上的實驗顯示，MERIT-Rank始終在競爭基準上實現了卓越的性能。<lb/>4B模型在BRIGHT上顯著超越了大多數7B甚至32B的重排序器。
